question: Do the three transvection-compatible Q_Rosati=602 residue classes fail already at the level of effectivity/integrality of a correspondence divisor class of bidegree (105,81) and self-intersection 15806 on C2xC2?

ex1_05g.exact_use: The fixed class has bidegree (105,81), Q_Rosati=602, Gamma^2=15806 and p_a(Gamma)=8090; every retained mod-2 survivor has an integral Q602 shell representative.

parent_05p.exact_use: The current receiver remains 29 Q states times the same three transvection-compatible residues; spin parity removes none.

d4d4_trace_reduction.exact_use: Q(T)=tr_2(T^dagger*T), Q is positive definite, and for a genuine correspondence of bidegree (a,b) the Rosati Gram matrix gives T^dagger*T <= ab I.

principal_rosati.exact_use: The principal Bolza Rosati involution and positive trace form are exact in the retained E^2 coordinates.

correspondence_intersection.external_source: Igor Dolgachev and Yuri G. Zarhin, Endomorphisms of Complex Abelian Varieties, Chapter 10 Section 10.1 equations (10.3)-(10.4)
correspondence_intersection.exact_use: For a divisor/correspondence D of bidegree (d1,d2), 2*d1*d2-D^2=2*Q(T). Polarization gives the mixed formula D.E=d1*e2+d2*e1-B_Q(T,S), with B_Q(T,T)=2Q(T).

pic_product_correspondence_surjection.title: Quadratic Chabauty for modular curves and modular forms of rank one
pic_product_correspondence_surjection.exact_use: Pic(C2xC2) -> Hom(J(C2),J(C2)) is surjective, with kernel the two pullback Picard groups. Hence an integral endomorphism T admits a line-bundle representative, and the two pullback factors can adjust its two bidegrees independently to (105,81).

reider.author: Igor Reider
reider.title: Vector bundles of rank 2 and linear systems on algebraic surfaces
reider.exact_use: If N is nef with N^2>=5 and |K+N| has a base point, there is an effective curve E with either N.E=0,E^2=-1 or N.E=1,E^2=0.

class_materialization_setup.construction: For any integral representative T with Q(T)=602, choose a line bundle L_T mapping to T under Pic(C2xC2)->End(J(C2)); twist by pullbacks from the two factors so that its bidegree is exactly (105,81).

adjoint_positive_part.mixed_intersection_formula: For a nonfibral integral curve C with bidegree (a,b) and correspondence S, N.C=103*b+79*a-B_Q(T,S).

reider_basepoint_replay.case_N_dot_E_one_E_square_zero_fibral: Impossible because a fiber has N-intersection 79 or 103.
reider_basepoint_replay.kodaira_vanishing: Because N is ample over C, H^i(K+N)=0 for i>0.

smooth_integral_member.bertini: The basepoint-free complete linear system |L_T| has a smooth general member over C.
smooth_integral_member.L_ample: L_T=K_Qsurf+N is ample because both K_Qsurf and N are ample.
smooth_integral_member.irreducibility_argument: If a smooth member split as disjoint nonzero components A+B, then A.B=0 and L.A=A^2>0, L.B=B^2>0; this would give a two-dimensional positive subspace for the surface intersection form, contradicting Hodge index. Hence a smooth member is integral.
smooth_integral_member.result: Every integral Q602 shell representative T, in particular representatives of residues 73,97,235, admits a smooth integral effective correspondence divisor of the exact bidegree/self-intersection numerical class.

low_genus_firewall.reason: Class-level effectivity/integrality does not produce the extreme singular member whose normalization has genus 106..134, nor the required Beauville/common-cover lift and local singularity data.

upgrade_of_05j.remaining_gap: No source-bound theorem makes the actual conductor/equigeneric conditions independent inside this very special complete linear system. Negative expected dimension is not an emptiness theorem.

decision.reopen_condition: To prune the three residues at class level, add geometry beyond numerical divisor class. To prune Q states, prove a member-specific singularity/conductor/monodromy incompatibility for a curve in |L_T| with normalization genus 106+r.

breadth_audit.trigger: 05Q materially changes the receiver by proving exact ampleness/basepoint-freeness and removing effectivity/integrality as possible blockers; the remaining issue is a special extreme-singularity realization problem.

generated_views.reason: Use exact N-ampleness/basepoint-freeness plus the actual conductor/adjoint ideal of an integral low-genus member. This is sharper than 05J generic k-very-ampleness because the positivity premise is now proved and the target is the member-specific conductor scheme.
05J already showed generic length-delta jet separation thresholds fail at the required scale; do not recharge it.
Earlier EX1 breadth work found the current surface numerical regime nonexcluding; 05Q does not change K^2/c2.
05N/05O/05P already isolated the obstruction-dominated Hurwitz count, the uniform transvection, and the missing coefficientwise spin profile.
Direct reconstruction remains decisive but is a dedicated EX2 lane; EX1 should import it only through an exact adapter rather than duplicate it.

next_route.selection_reason: 05Q proves the ambient correspondence linear systems are positive and contain smooth integral curves. The nearest remaining non-reconstruction question is whether an actual integral member can carry a conductor/adjoint scheme of colength delta=7956..7984 while satisfying the common-cover constraints; test the member-specific global-to-local evaluation map rather than generic jet separation.
